subject: Q3 stewardship & routing: updated squad handoffs and escalation matrix
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.in>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.in>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.in>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 stewardship & routing: draft handoff proposal

Team —

I put together an initial proposal for how we should shift squad stewardship and request routing for Q3. Goal is straightforward: reduce cross-squad triage latency for customer escalations and consolidate primary ownership for E2E features during rollout windows. High-level changes:  

- Move Platform Observability (formerly shared) to Owning-Squad: Core Serving (owner: Marcus/Platform).
- Introduce a Tiered Escalation Matrix: L1 (squad on-call) -> L2 (platform triage pod) -> L3 (senior eng & product rotation).
- Pilot a single-point squad steward for top-20 enterprise accounts (rotate every 8 weeks).

I've attached a handoff matrix and a draft of the updated OKRs that align to these ownership changes. The pilot includes AceroHealth — they go live mid-August and represent a good, bounded test case.

Asks: please review the matrix and OKRs and call out any conflicts with planned hires/bench strength or customer commitments. If we agree by EOD Friday, I'll share a short comms bundle for execs and the account team.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.in>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.in>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 stewardship & routing: draft handoff proposal

Jonas —

Thanks for this. High-level looks sensible. A couple of items I want to call out before we lock it:  

1) Capacity for the Platform triage pod during AceroHealth go-live. We have two planned engineers joining Platform in late August — if the pilot is a priority we should shift one start earlier or reduce scope for the first two weeks.
2) Customer comms: recommend a pre-scheduled 30-minute sync with Acero technical leads that includes the rotated steward introduction and SLA expectations. Megan from Acero prefers late-morning PT.
3) OKR alignment: please add a specific KR around mean time to acknowledge (MTA) for enterprise incidents — that will make the impact measurable for QBR.

I inserted inline suggested language in the attached Q3 OKRs doc. If we tighten on staffing I'll approve the pilot.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success

Quick clarifying Qs from a comms perspective:  

- For the single-point steward rotation, who is the escalation contact for customers after hours? If it remains the squad on-call we should make that explicit in the comms.
- On the handoff matrix, can we add a "playbook version" column so PMs can see when the runbook was last updated?

If the pilot includes Acero, I'm happy to draft the steward intro email and the FAQ they can use at launch.

Tessa

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.in>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.in>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.in>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 stewardship & routing: draft handoff proposal

All —

Agree with Laura and Tessa. A couple of practical notes from the product side:  

- Make the steward role non-blocking for roadmaps: stewards handle customer routing and escalation, but feature ownership remains with the product squad (we should avoid confusion in PL timelines).
- Suggest adding a Canary rollback trigger in the handoff matrix: if an account sees more than X% error rate for two consecutive deploys, auto-roll to previous variant and engage L3.
- I'll add a KR for MTA (target: 15 minutes for enterprise-critical) and pair it with a dashboard tile in the Console for tracking.

I can bake these edits into the Q3 OKRs doc and the handoff matrix. If you want, I can also draft the short one-pager that we send to execs.

-Stephanie

--
Stephanie Nguyen

From: Denise Hart <denise.hart@consults.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.in>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.in>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.in>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 stewardship & routing: draft handoff proposal — redlines

Folks —

I reviewed the matrix and OKR wording with a particular eye toward external-facing language and procurement concerns. Two redlines for consideration:  

1) SLA wording: avoid promising "24/7 steward ownership" for pilot customers unless we specify on-call compensation and an escalation overlay; use "primary steward" and define hours.
2) Procurement asks: Acero's procurement team requested explicit data residency language in the pilot comms. Suggest an appendix that points to our deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and clarifies Acero's current deployment.

I've attached a marked-up PDF with suggested phrasing. Happy to hop on a quick call with Megan if you want me to smooth language before it goes external.

—Denise

Denise Hart
Principal Consultant, Customer Launches
Consults.Co
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.in>
To: Megan Lee <megan@acerohealth.com>, procurement@acerohealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.in>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.in>, Denise Hart <denise.hart@consults.co>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Steward introduction + Q3 pilot plan (AceroHealth)

Megan / Acero team —

Thanks again for partnering with us on this pilot. Per our internal planning, attached are the steward handoff matrix and a short Q3 OKR summary that explains how we'll measure success. Key points for this pilot:  

- Primary steward: Laura Bennett (Customer Success) — primary hours Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm PT. After-hours incidents will follow the standard squad on-call escalation path (documented in the attached matrix).
- Escalation matrix: L1 (squad on-call) -> L2 (Platform triage pod) -> L3 (senior rotation). We will not promise 24/7 dedicated steward coverage for the pilot.
- Success metrics: MTA (acknowledge) target 15 minutes, deployment rollback trigger defined in the matrix, and NPS touch at 30 days post-launch.

Next steps: Tessa will schedule the steward intro call for Aug 10 at 10:30am PT (pending your confirmation). Stephanie will share a one-pager and the dashboard tile for your review. Denise, thanks for the suggested procurement language — we'll include a short appendix on data residency.

If anything here looks off, loop me in and we can adjust quickly. Otherwise we'll proceed with the comms and the Aug 10 intro call.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
